title: Travel line on the story card
caption: Basic at 1500 px on Watchful Eyes: the turn-in's Kibelisk is bound and in another zone, so one line says to teleport to Temporary Retreat (1 scroll), then 401 m, with an I'll walk button. It takes the place of the Kibelisk hint.

title: Travel line and Prefer running in Advanced
caption: Advanced shows the same line, and a Prefer running box under the Next up header; ticking it turns the travel line off on this device.

title: Travel line on a phone
caption: On a phone in Basic the line sits under the card text, above Turned in; Basic has no settings, so no Prefer running box.

title: Travel line on a phone, Advanced
caption: On a phone in Advanced: the Prefer running box under the header, the line and a 44 px I'll walk button on the featured story card.
